page.overview:
Who is Lightning's Final Fantasy XIII battle and field exploration quotes?

Lightning is the main playable character in Final Fantasy XIII, who utters various lines of dialogue during battle, depending on actions taken and the part of the game the player is in, and when she is in the party on the field during free exploration.

Cocoon's nothing to you?! —First fight against Barthandelus.

All those lives... —Second fight against Barthandelus.

So you're behind all this? —First fight against Orphan.
